messages:
Alex Chen: Heads up — EdgeCloud's UX Connector POC kickoff tomorrow. Need final alignment on entitlements, egress, and routing. Jordan from EdgeCloud will join. Quick list: SSO, dedicated sandbox, pricing cap, security questionnaire. Who can take network/egress and sandbox provisioning?
Priya Nair: I can take sandbox + tenant creds. Need IP ranges and egress policy. Jordan — can you send CIDR & expected peak TPS?
Jordan (EdgeCloud): Sending ranges now: app 10.14.0.0/21, egress 54.210.0.0/22. Peak steady ~120 TPS, burst to 400 for ~30s. Can Redwood guarantee <120ms p95 in us-west-2 with a dedicated small pool?
Samir Patel: tagging eng-runtime — p95 depends on model & prompt length. For short prompts on 2xA10 equiv with no quant, we typically see ~90–110ms p95. If they use embeddings or 8k context add ~30–60ms. Autoscale for 400 TPS doable but needs commit.
Alex Chen: Priya — what's ETA to stand up sandbox? Also Security Q form — Jordan, do you accept our standard non-prod questionnaire or need custom fields?
Priya Nair: I can spin the env in ~6h once CIDRs and SSO metadata present. For SSO we need IdP metadata XML + SP ACS URL. For the Security Q, we have a "non-prod" tailored form; I can share link.
Jordan (EdgeCloud): We'll provide IdP metadata. Our security team asked for SOC2 evidence and encryption-at-rest details — is there a single doc we can point them to?
Samir Patel: Ping docs: https://redwood.ai/docs/security#compliance — includes SOC2, KMS/HSM, TLS. Short summary: "Data at rest encrypted; customer KMS supported; audit logs available; TLS 1.2+ in transit."
Priya Nair: For the sandbox I need entitlement flags: embeddings, streaming, long-context, kvcache. Jordan — which features are required for the UX flows?
Jordan (EdgeCloud): Need embeddings + streaming + long-context (8k). Also want KV-prefix cache to speed up chat flows. Pricing: we requested a 90-day trial credit + a preferred committed rate for dedicated — need a number by EOD.
Alex Chen: Sales wants a firm-rate to propose. Recommend we offer trial credit + temporary committed rate. Finance/Eng — any quick guardrails or redlines? Legal might ask for a DPA addendum.
Samir Patel: Ballpark: small dedicated pool (2xA10 equiv) ~ $8k/mo committed. Trial credit separate (e.g., $10k). I'll confirm with pricing ops.
Priya Nair: Provisioning plan: I'll create tenant edge-ux-poc and pre-enable features. Command I'll run: 
```
redwoodctl tenant create --name edge-ux-poc --region us-west-2 --features embeddings,streaming,kvcache --cidrs 10.14.0.0/21 --egress 54.210.0.0/22
```
Credentials will be put in the shared secret manager; invites sent to Jordan.
Jordan (EdgeCloud): Works for us. After provision can you run a quick perf test? We'll run our harness and share results.
Alex Chen: Blocker: security Q item about 'log data residency' — Jordan, ok to keep logs US-only?
Jordan (EdgeCloud): Yes, US-only is fine.
Priya Nair: Noted — will set log region to us-west-2. Also confirm KMS: do you want customer-managed? If yes, send KMS ARN.
Jordan (EdgeCloud): We'll use EdgeCloud KMS. Sharing ARN in DM.
Samir Patel: Action items recap: Priya — provisioning (ETA ~6h). Samir — confirm committed pricing with finance. Alex — coordinate legal/DPA. Jordan — send IdP metadata + KMS ARN + confirm trial acceptance. I'll stand up perf runner once tenant ready.
Alex Chen: Quick sync at 4pm PT after sandbox up. @Onboarding Bot please create task checklist for this POC.
Onboarding Bot: Created task list #1234 — tenant provision; #1235 — SSO metadata; #1236 — security docs; #1237 — perf test. Assigned to Priya, Jordan, Alex, Samir. ETA 4pm PT.
Priya Nair: :thumbsup: Will update channel with tenant link when done.
Jordan (EdgeCloud): :thumbsup: thanks team.
Samir Patel: One more note — if they want autoscale for 400 TPS bursts without a long commit, we can enable short-term burst (3x reserved) for 24h but it will be billed as overage. Good to confirm now so we can temp-config.
Priya Nair: Noted. I'll include env details in the shared secret: redwood_api_url, tenant_id, admin_token.
Alex Chen: Great progress. Thanks everyone — let's aim to close the pricing + DPA by EOD so the POC can start tomorrow.
